You and I are in a similar position. I'm 20, and attempting to finally grow a beard after leaving a job that otherwise prohibited it. Likewise, my 'Stacie doesn't quite reach the beard, and the full face is much thinner than the neck.

However, a good thing to consider when starting out is what you're looking for. Long and bushy? Trim and clean lines? Neck or not?

Personally, I like to keep mine squared on the cheeks (as much as it will allow), trimmed at a length I want (while waiting for a fill), and off the neck. About 2 fingers above the Adams apple is where I cut (same way I pour my drinks). Feel free to try a few looks out, as you can always start over.

Regardless of the fill of your beard, proper grooming is what separates a scraggly mess from something presentable. Cleaning up your neckline (if any), preventing split and brittle ends, and combing/brushing in a well-groomed manner will allow even the most patchy of beards to fly by. I know I have a few years 'til proper growth, but by keeping it trimmed I feel presentable enough to wear it with pride.
